fieldNotes.location: Roster point (42.039983,-75.79687, geocode precision APPROXIMATE) fell in a residential area of Kirkwood ~6 km SE of the plant. Web research resolved the true address to 10 Spud Ln, Binghamton/Kirkwood NY 13795/13904; Nominatim placed Spud Lane at 42.0982,-75.8403. Satellite there shows the Frito-Lay snack plant on the Susquehanna River; Street View confirmed silos, a steam plume from the fryers, and a blue Frito-Lay sign.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Single dedicated plant access road runs from a signalized public-road intersection (~42.0997,-75.8374) across a rail line into the property. Controlled-access industrial campus; no Street View available on the private drive so a barrier arm could not be directly imaged, but a controlled checkpoint is standard for a major Frito-Lay manufacturing plant. Medium confidence.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No clearly resolvable guard booth in satellite at the entrance; classified remoteGs (gate, no visible shack). Low confidence - the booth, if present, sits along the unviewable private drive.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Extensive trailer storage: dozens of trailers parked in long marked rows on the west/southwest side of the property along the river. Easily 50+ stalls.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Trailers visible backed into dock faces on the SW side of the main building; door count estimated at ~40 from overhead imagery - approximate.
fieldNotes.railServed: An active rail line runs along the NE edge of the property between the plant and the road; the plant historically receives bulk inbound (potatoes/corn/oil). Spur appears to serve the plant though it also parallels neighboring industrial parcels.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Kirkwood is a small town SE of Binghamton; the plant sits in a riverside small-town industrial corridor - classified Rural per rubric tie-break.

citations.claim: New East Fishkill DC receives snacks from the Kirkwood NY manufacturing facility, i.e. Kirkwood is active.
Active 2025 Frito-Lay hostler/forklift postings at Kirkwood NY.

verification.rationale: WATCH RESOLVED: the closed PopCorners site is Liberty NY, not Kirkwood/Binghamton; Kirkwood is a distinct active snack plant feeding East Fishkill and hiring in 2025.
